text: I ate at the food court and already reported it to the mall's Facebook page with a video, but received no response. I'd like to suggest improving hygiene because I found a cockroach crawling in front of the noodle stall where I ate, about to put the vegetables in the tray. I informed the noodle vendor, but they didn't pay attention, so I had to move the tray myself. This was in front of the stall; imagine what it's like behind the stall! It makes me think...
The parking area is very spacious, and there are a wide variety of shops nearby, including restaurants, clothing stores, telecommunications companies, banks, etc

text: The customer service counter has only one employee working; the rest are standing around applying lipstick or resting their chins on their hands. The service is extremely slow. If you use this service, be prepared for slow service. When will this be improved?

author_name: ชาญทอง เสียงสุวรรณ

text: I came to buy grilled chicken marinated in milk and asked if the staff could chop the chicken for me. There was a staff member standing at the fresh food counter, boiling meatballs, so I asked. But the staff member frowned, glanced at me out of the corner of their eye, and didn't answer my question. When I asked again, they said they didn't know where the person in charge was and that it wasn't their job to chop the chicken. Their tone was very unwilling to provide service.

The parking lot is huge, but you might have to park a bit far away. Walking into the mall is difficult because there's no covered pedestrian walkway. You have to walk behind the cars, constantly being careful of cars backing out of their parking spaces. It's quite a long walk, and dangerous for cars if you're not careful about pedestrians. The covered areas are practically unusable.

Inside the mall, there are tons of food options; I didn't expect it to be this big.
There's a wide variety of shops, including a Major Cineplex.

I especially liked the many massage chairs, but I suggest they should be positioned further away for more privacy; they're facing the pedestrian walkway instead.

The restrooms are very clean and well-maintained.
